	[Tooltip("Every scene that is part of the SAME LOGICAL PLACE as this one — e.g. WildwoodForestPartIVa through IVe are all 'Part IV' to a player. Quest and event scene locks ask this list whether the player is 'here'.\n\nThis exists because NavMeshParent cannot answer that question: an area too large to bake as one NavMesh gets split across SEVERAL parents (Part IV is IVa/IVb/IVc under IVa, and IVd under IVe), so nav grouping reports one place as two.\n\nNOT MapConglomerates — that is map scope (every scene drawn on the Wildwood map) and is far too broad to lock a quest to.\n\nMembership is symmetric: listing the other scene on either handler is enough. Leave empty for a scene whose NavMesh group already matches its logical area — the nav group is still honoured as a fallback.")]
